name: Deeds
pages: Deeds are items that are used to add $(l:parcels)Parcels$(/l) to the world. Using a Deed in an unclaimed space will place a $(l:foundation_stones)Foundation Stone$(/l). The $(l:border_buffer)Border$(/l) outline and $(l:border_buffer)Buffer$(/l) outline will be displayed with the Foundation Stone as the origin. Using the Deed again on the Foundation Stone will accept the location (if it is not overlapping) and create a new Parcel, with the Deed holder as the Owner. The Deed is then consumed.

pages.title: Crafting / Obtaining
pages.text: Deeds cannot be crafted. Deeds are meant to be used as rewards, loot, or distributed by mods (ex Custom Starting Gear) or Ops/Admin. Deeds can be generated by Commands by a Nation owner or by Ops.

pages.title: Deed Types
pages.text: Except for Zone, there is a respective Deed for each Parcel.$(br2)$(thing)Zone Parcels are designated spaces within Nations, meant to be set by the Nation owner, and not claimed with a Deed.$(br)Zones can be created by a Nation owner using $(l:commands)Commands$(/l) or the $(l:tools)Zone Placement Tool$(/l).

pages.title: Player Deed
pages.text: Can be used anywhere, including in a Zone Parcel in a Open border Nation Parcel, or can be used to claim an abandoned Citizen Parcel in an Open border Nation.

pages.title: Citizen Deed
pages.text: Can be used in a Zone Parcel or can be used to claim an abandoned Citizen Parcel of the same Nation, or in an Open border Nation.

pages.title: Nation Deed
pages.text: Must be a top-level Parcel ie can be used anywhere that doesn't overlap another Parcel.

pages.title: Deed Sizes
pages.text: Deed sizes can be completely customized to any size (within world limits. ie can't be bigger than World height).$(br)Four dimensions are used when generating a Deed - $(l)X$(), $(l)Up$(), $(l)Down$(), $(l)Z$(). The Up and Down dimensions are used instead of Y because the vertical dimension is based around the Foundation Stone that is placed into the world.

pages: Ex. size = 10 10 10 10, pos = 100.$(br)The size is (100 90 100) -> (110 109 110)$(br)$(italic)Why 109? because the range is inclusive, ie pos at 100 is included$().$(br2)Splitting the vertical dimension into Up and Down also allows the Player to claim space below the placement pos without having to dig down first. However if you wanted to only have Up values, you can do that.$(br)Ex. size = 10 0 20 10.
Nation Deeds ignore the Up and Down values and extend to the entire World height.

pages.title: Pre-made Deeds
pages.text: By design, Deeds are meant to be generated by Admin / Ops and Nation owners so that they can be customized, however some pre-made Deeds have been added and are available in the Creative Tabs. They have various sizes:$(li)Parcel Deeds at 10x10x10x10, 16x16x16x16, 32x32x32x32($li)Nation Deeds at 100x100, 200x200

pages: Note - there aren't any pre-made Citizen Deeds because need to be generated from an existing Nation Parcel.
